body.message:
Regarding yesterday, our team reached out to you by call and message solely to follow up on your checkout/extension, as previously discussed with you and the authority. As agreed, we extended your stay by one week and provided you the pricing at the old rate, along with the booking confirmation.

However, to date, the payment for this extension has not been received. Without payment, the extension cannot be considered confirmed.

We kindly ask you to arrange the payment at your earliest convenience so this can be settled.

Regards,
